arxiv-2212-02882.title: Electromagnetic Information Theory: Fundamentals, Modeling, Applications, and Open Problems
arxiv-2212-02882.creator: Jieao Zhu, Student Member, IEEE , Zhongzhichao Wan, Student Member, IEEE , Linglong Dai, Fellow, IEEE , Mérouane Debbah, Fellow, IEEE , and H. Vincent Poor, Life Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2212-02882.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jieao Zhu, Student Member, IEEE , Zhongzhichao Wan, Student Member, IEEE , Linglong Dai, Fellow, IEEE , Mérouane Debbah, Fellow, IEEE , and H. Vincent Poor, Life Fellow, IEEE. Traditional massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) information theory adopt non-physically consistent assumptions, including white-noised, scalar-quantity, far-field, discretized, and monochromatic EM fields, which mismatch the nature of the underlying electromagnetic (EM) fields supporting the physical layer of wireless communication systems.

arxiv-2306-11817.title: Towards a Definition of Complex Software System
arxiv-2306-11817.creator: Jan Žižka, Bruno Rossi, Tomáš Pitner
arxiv-2306-11817.description: Abstract Complex Systems were identified and studied in different fields, such as physics, biology, and economics. These systems exhibit exciting properties such as self-organization, robust order, and emergence. In recent years, software systems displaying behaviors associated with Complex Systems are starting to appear, and these behaviors are showing previously unknown potential (e.g., GPT-based applications).

arxiv-2311-17752.title: BAND-2k: Banding Artifact Noticeable Database for Banding Detection and Quality Assessment
arxiv-2311-17752.creator: Zijian Chen ID, Wei Sun, Jun Jia, Fangfang Lu, Zicheng Zhang, Jing Liu, Ru Huang, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai
arxiv-2311-17752.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zijian Chen ID, Wei Sun, Jun Jia, Fangfang Lu, Zicheng Zhang, Jing Liu, Ru Huang, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai. Banding, also known as staircase-like contours, frequently occurs in flat areas of images/videos processed by the compression or quantization algorithms. As undesirable artifacts, banding destroys the original image structure, thus inevitably degrading users’ quality of experience (QoE). In this paper, we systematically investigate the banding image quality assessment (IQA) problem, aiming to detect the image banding artifacts and evaluate their perceptual visual quality.

arxiv-2506-00369.title: The Interplay between Additive and Multiplicative Central Sets Theorems
arxiv-2506-00369.creator: Pintu Debnath, Sayan Goswami, Chunlin Liu
arxiv-2506-00369.description: Abstract The concept of Central sets, introduced by Furstenberg through the framework of topological dynamics, has played a pivotal role in combinatorial number theory. Furstenberg’s Central Sets Theorem highlighted their rich combinatorial structure. Later in [ 3 ] , De, Hindman, and Strauss strengthen this theorem using the algebraic framework of the Stone–Čech compactification.

arxiv-2507-06069.title: RTGPU: Real-Time Computing with Graphics Processing Units
arxiv-2507-06069.creator: Atiyeh Gheibi-Fetrat, Amirsaeed Ahmadi-Tonekaboni, Farzam Koohi-Ronaghi, Pariya Hajipour, Sana Babayan-Vanestan, Fatemeh Fotouhi, Elahe Mortazavian-Farsani, Pouria Khajehpour-Dezfouli, Sepideh Safari, Shaahin Hessabi, Hamid Sarbazi-Azad
arxiv-2507-06069.description: Abstract In this work, we survey the role of GPUs in real-time systems. Originally designed for parallel graphics workloads, GPUs are now widely used in time-critical applications such as machine learning, autonomous vehicles, and robotics due to their high computational throughput. Their parallel architecture is well-suited for accelerating complex tasks under strict timing constraints.

arxiv-2510-15511.title: Language Models are Injective and Hence Invertible
arxiv-2510-15511.creator: Giorgos Nikolaou Tommaso Mencattini Donato Crisostomi Andrea Santilli Yannis Panagakis Emanuele Rodolà, [3ex] Sapienza University of Rome EPFL University of Athens Archimedes RC
arxiv-2510-15511.description: Abstract Transformer components such as non-linear activations and normalization are inherently non-injective, suggesting that different inputs could map to the same output and prevent exact recovery of the input from a model’s representations. In this paper, we challenge this view.

arxiv-2510-18677.title: Modeling Polaron Excitations and Stabilization Mechanisms in Conjugated Polymers
arxiv-2510-18677.creator: Vishal Jindal, Scott T. Milner ∗
arxiv-2510-18677.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vishal Jindal, Scott T. Milner ∗. Charge carriers in organic semiconductors form polarons, which are self-localized states stabilized by interactions with their environment. Using a dielectric-stabilized tight-binding model parameterized from first-principles calculations, we compute ground and excited polaron states in poly(3-hexylthiophene) (P3HT). Our results quantitatively reproduce key mid-infrared absorption features, notably the chain-length-dependent shift of the intrachain polaron excitation peak (peak B) and its variation between regioregular and regiorandom P3HT.

arxiv-2512-22353.title: Tableaux and orbit harmonics quotients for finite transformation monoids
arxiv-2512-22353.creator: Mihalis Maliakas, Dimitra-Dionysia Stergiopoulou
arxiv-2512-22353.description: Abstract . We extend Grood’s tableau construction of irreducible representations of the rook monoid and Steinberg’s analogous result for the full transformation monoid. Our approach is characteristic-free and applies to any submonoid ℳ ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{M}(n) of the partial transformation monoid on an n n -element set that contains the symmetric group.

pmc-11472182.title: Nonclinical evaluations of deucravacitinib and Janus kinase inhibitors in homeostatic and inflammatory pathways
pmc-11472182.creator: Brandon Johnson, Lihong Cheng, Jennifer Koenitzer, Ian M. Catlett, Peter Schafer
pmc-11472182.description: Translational medicine provides insight into novel drugs and predicts unwanted effects. In well-characterized pathways (e.g., cytokine-Janus kinase [JAK]-signal transducers and activators of transcription [STAT]), a variety of in vitro assessments were used to estimate selectivity of effects on different potential targets (i.e., JAK1, JAK2, JAK3, and tyrosine kinase 2 [TYK2]).

pmc-11489401.title: Human exposure to air contaminants under the far-UVC system operation in an office: effects of lamp position and ventilation condition
pmc-11489401.creator: Seongjun Park, Donghyun Rim
pmc-11489401.description: The far-UVC (222 nm) system has emerged as a solution for controlling airborne transmission, yet its effect on indoor air quality, particularly concerning positioning, remains understudied. In this study, we examined the impact of far-UVC lamp position on the disinfection and secondary contaminant formation in a small office.

pmc-11675646.title: Identification and Expression Analysis of Lipoxygenase Gene in Bitter Gourd (Momordica charantia)
pmc-11675646.creator: Haicui Ge, Shuang Liu, Hongzhe Zheng, Pengyan Chang, Weiqun Huang, Shanshan Lin, Jingyuan Zheng, Honglong Li, Zedong Huang, Qi Jia, Fenglin Zhong, Zhipeng Liu
pmc-11675646.description: Background: Lipoxygenases (LOXs) are key enzymes in the unsaturated fatty acid oxidation reaction pathway and play an important regulatory role in the synthesis of fruit aroma volatiles. Methods: LOX gene family members were identified in the whole genome database of bitter gourd and analyzed bioinformatically. An RT-qPCR was used to analyze the expression differences in different tissues.

pmc-12562723.title: Barriers to influenza vaccination in older adults with chronic diseases: Insights from a COM-B model–based meta-analysis
pmc-12562723.creator: Luo Jiang, Jin Zhao, Hui Jin
pmc-12562723.description: This study investigated barriers to influenza vaccination among older adults with chronic diseases through a systematic review of 21 studies (391 467 participants, 13 countries) following PRISMA guidelines. According to the COM-B framework, barriers in the capability (OR = 1.47), opportunity (OR = 2.07) and motivation (OR = 1.35) dimensions significantly influenced influenza vaccination behaviors.

pmc-12603491.title: A nomogram for preoperative prediction of invasiveness in solitary pulmonary adenocarcinoma: a multicenter study
pmc-12603491.creator: Xiaocui Liu, Dan Wang, Xiuying Yang, Xiaofei Yue, Chuansheng Zheng, Liming Xia, Xuefeng Kan
pmc-12603491.description: BackgroundThe invasive pulmonary adenocarcinoma and preinvasive-minimally invasive lesions usually need different surgical operation methods. This study aims to develop a clinical prediction model for preoperatively assessing invasiveness in solitary pulmonary adenocarcinoma.MethodsFrom January 2020 to December 2024, patients with solitary pulmonary nodules who underwent preoperative computed tomography (CT) scans in four centers were included.

pmc-12731927.title: Comprehension as Purification in Reading
pmc-12731927.creator: Miho Fuyama, Rosario Lo Franco
pmc-12731927.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). When reading a novel or poem, readers sometimes gain comprehension or experiences that cannot be expressed in language yet are felt as holistic. Previous studies focused on the linguistically expressible aspects of text comprehension. In this study, we propose a new hypothesis, the purification comprehension hypothesis, that seeks to explain how a reader constructs indescribable and coherent comprehension using quantum probability theory.

pmc-13214876.title: Assessment of Population Immunity to Enteric Hepatitis Viruses in the Population of Belgrade
pmc-13214876.creator: Anna Yurievna Popova, Alesia Yuryevna Olkhovskaya, Luka Dragačević, Yulia Vladimirovna Ostankova, Svetlana Alexandrovna Egorova, Alexander Nikolaevich Schemelev, Darya Tsibulskaya, Ekaterina Vladimirovna Anufrieva, Anastasiya Romanovna Ivanova, Irina Victorovna Drozd, Ojuna Bayarovna Zhimbaeva, Bran
pmc-13214876.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Hepatitis A (HA) and E (HE) represent a significant global health burden. Despite the development of effective vaccines against hepatitis A virus (HAV) and hepatitis E virus (HEV), outbreaks of acute HA and HE continue to occur worldwide. This study aimed to assess the seroprevalence of anti-HAV and anti-HEV IgG antibodies (Abs) in the population of Belgrade and to analyze their association with socio-demographic and clinical factors.

pmc-13369534.creator: Johanna C. Wagner, Lena Wagner, Anna Widder, Regina Pistorius, Matthias Kelm, Nicolas Schlegel, Florian Seyfried, Armin Wiegering, Christian Markus, Patrick Meybohm, Christoph-Thomas Germer, Wolfgang Schwenk, Sven Flemming
